text:
raja.prodeng: Heads-up everyone  we're planning a small but broad billing update next week that affects onboarding credits, invoice line-items, and a new soft overage policy. Posting draft for review.

billing-bot: [Draft] Saved to /internal/drafts/billing-refresh-2026 (preview link)

maria.billing: TL;DR: 1) Platform-issued onboarding credits for new self-serve orgs will stop for signups after 2026-09-01. Existing credits remain valid until expiration. 2) Invoice CSV gets clearer line items and a couple new metadata columns. 3) Hosted accounts get a 48h overage grace window before charges apply.

cfo.sara: This is not a unit price change  it's aimed at clearer metering and fewer surprise charges. We've modeled churn and will run a retention voucher program for qualifying teams.

engops.june: Ops notes: Overages are held for 48h to allow upgrades/commitments; after that we invoice and may throttle per normal rules. Dedicated customers unaffected. We'll log start/end events and expose them in the audit stream.

support.ali: Support prep: please draft canned replies. Suggested reply: "Your existing credits stay valid until they expire. New signups after Sept 1 will not receive automatic onboarding credits; we offer a short discount for eligible teams."

maria.billing: CSV/export change: add columns -> line_type, usage_units, unit_price, region_code, schema_version. We'll include a header line like `schema_version=7`. Example snippet in docs.

raja.prodeng: Communication plan: internal heads-up today, help center article + blog tomorrow, targeted email to affected orgs on 2026-08-28. Export schema migration window: 2026-08-30 02:00-03:00 UTC (exports may produce schema_version=6 or 7 during the window).

cfo.sara: Finance: we'll map new line_types to GL. Expect a small reconciliation effort first month. Please flag any accounting blockers.

engops.june: Engineering callout: adding region_code and schema_version is backwards-compatible if we include the header and bump export semver. We'll post python/js parsing snippets. Also recommend publishing an advisory to downstream CSV consumers.

maria.billing: Tone guidance: avoid "removing free trials" phrasing. Use "updating onboarding credit program to better align with product and billing improvements."

support.ali: Partner question: partner-provisioned credits?

maria.billing: Partners can still issue credits via partner tooling. Platform default changes only. We'll notify partner teams separately.

raja.prodeng: Action items: Product: update signup UX copy. Support: canned responses + refund playbook. Eng: export changes + SDK changelog. Billing: prepare voucher workflow for retention offers. Legal/Finance: final sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: [Automated] Owners: @maria.billing (billing), @raja.prodeng (comms), @engops.june (ops)

raja.prodeng: If there are no blockers, announce on 2026-08-28 16:00 UTC. Please flag issues here before EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

support.ali: Quick follow-up: will there be a visible meter in the console showing the 48h grace countdown?

engops.june: Yes  console will show a small "overage grace" badge with start time and expiry. API/audit events will mirror that.
